symptom: prisma-public-content.repository.spec.ts timed out in CI before any test ran
rootcause: The Testcontainers Postgres container startup time exceeded the default Vitest test timeout. The container needed to pull the image, start, and run Prisma migrations before the first test could execute
fix: Increased the Vitest hookTimeout for this spec file to allow sufficient time for Testcontainers startup and migration
